data.narrative:
Glimpse is a Series A climate and energy company founded by Eric Moch and six co-founders, having raised $17M to date. The valuation universe comprises one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers in the Climate & Energy sector, including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

The stage-progression method is applicable and anchors the analysis. Using total capital raised ($17M) as a proxy for post-money valuation and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $34M. The peer-median method is not applicable due to an insufficient narrow comparable set; while eight same-sector peers exist, zero met the filters for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier comparables, making a sector-wide median potentially misleading.

The triangulated analysis rests on a single method, yielding a median of $34M with a low of $29M and high of $39M. The range reflects reasonable variance around the stage-progression anchor but carries material uncertainty. Key limitations include reliance on a single valuation method and the absence of narrow-set peer data to cross-validate stage-appropriate multiples. A fuller analysis would require either identifying additional same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables in frontier energy or obtaining direct market signals from recent rounds in the sector.
